title: RGXAddon declarative options table
description: The opts table accepted by RGXAddon(name, opts) / RGXAddon "Name" { }. Governed by the additive Simplicity Contract in docs/DECLARATIVE-API.md: keys and grammars never silently change meaning. Keys marked x-rgx-ships:"today" are implemented in core/core.lua RGX.Addon; keys marked "tier4" are frozen future targets, not yet implemented. Lua functions cannot be expressed in JSON; they are modeled as {"$lua":"function"} placeholders for validation purposes.

table.description: Optional pre-existing table to become the addon object (RGX.Addon augments it in place).

brand.description: Hex color (no #) for the chat prefix. Default 58be81.

slash.description: Slash command(s) without the leading slash. Bare: string or array of aliases; the assumed handler opens the options panel. Advanced: the same table plus handler = function(addon, msg) when opening the panel is not the right default. Contract rule 4: Tier 4 defaults this to the lowercase addon name when omitted.

oneOf.description: Advanced form. In JSON transcription the Lua table's array part (the aliases) becomes numeric-string keys.

minimap.description: Bare: true = minimap button with default icon; string = icon texture path. The assumed left-click opens the options panel and the dragged angle persists to addon.db. Advanced: a full minimap-button opts table (tooltip, defaultAngle, onRightClick, onCtrlRight, angleKey, ...) passed through to the minimap module's Create.

oneOf.description: Advanced passthrough form. Unlisted keys pass through to MM:Create.

db.description: Profile defaults table. Creates addon.db (RGX:NewDatabase proxy) on ADDON_LOADED. SavedVariables name defaults to <Name>DB with non-identifier characters stripped from the name ("RGX-Hello" -> RGXHelloDB, matching rgx_generate_addon); pass dbName to override (contract rule 4).

dbName.description: Override the SavedVariables name (default <Name>DB). Must match a ## SavedVariables entry in the consumer TOC.

global.description: Passed through to RGX:NewDatabase opts.global (cross-character storage).

title.description: Options panel title. Defaults to the addon name (contract rule 4).

options.description: Tab name -> array of controls. Requires db. Every control binds to addon.db with automatic save AND restore. Layout model (one composable vocabulary, proven in BLU): panel -> main page + tabs -> tabs can be multi-paged -> 1-2 column card grid -> rows/cards holding the widgets. Tier 4 adds the reserved key 'columns' (1|2|3 card grid; 1-2 is the BLU-proven range), multi-page tab support, and one-line string controls per the contract grammar.

columns.description: Card-grid column count for all tabs. 1-2 proven in BLU; 3 contract-frozen.

welcome.description: Message printed with the addon's branded prefix on load.

onInit.description: function(addon) called on ADDON_LOADED after db/options are ready. The escape hatch for imperative setup.

on.description: Human trigger vocabulary -> handler. Trigger names are plain words mapped 1:1 to framework modules (contract rule 2); any UPPER_CASE key passes through as a raw WoW event (escape hatch). See the contract's trigger table.

every.description: Named repeating timers with printable names containing a non-space character. Each timer starts after the addon's ADDON_LOADED database/options/minimap setup, first fires after its interval, and calls function(addon, timer). Names provide deterministic same-declaration dispatch and stable diagnostic labels; handlers remain failure-isolated and may self-cancel with addon:CancelTimer(timer).

luaFunction.description: A Lua function. JSON representation for tooling: {"$lua": "function"}.

triggerName.description: The frozen trigger vocabulary (contract: additive-only — this enum only grows).

control.description: One options control. Today: table forms. Tier 4 adds one-line string forms per the contract grammar.

controlString.description: One-line control string, contract grammar: "toggle <key> ['Label']" | "slider <key> <min>-<max> [step] ['Label']" | "dropdown <key> a|b|c ['Label']" | "color <key> ['Label']" | "font <key> ['Label']" | "button 'Text' <method>" | "header 'Text'" | "label 'Text'". Labels inferred from keys when omitted.

suffix.description: appended to the displayed value, e.g. "%"

default.description: Assumed from the db defaults for the key when omitted.
